module_name_en: Core Words III and Graded Reading
block_note: The emails in this block use the header and closing apparatus taught in levels 20 and 21 — विषय, महोदय, सादर — so the vocabulary block pays off here rather than being tested in isolation. The last item is the module's first news text.

grammar_prep_card.title_en: Conditionals with If and Then (अगर ... तो)
grammar_prep_card.explanation_en: Conditional sentences in Hindi use the pair 'अगर ... तो' (if ... then) or 'यदि ... तो'. While English often drops 'then' ('If it rains, we won't go'), Hindi almost always includes the correlative 'तो': 'अगर बारिश हुई तो हम नहीं जाएँगे'. Sometimes 'अगर' is dropped, leaving 'तो' alone to carry the conditional meaning. The formal equivalent of 'अगर' is 'यदि', which you will see on official or written notices.

learn.title_en: तिथि and तारीख़ in the same breath
learn.explanation_en: स्मरण is remembrance, and स्मरण रहे कि — let it be remembered that — is how a formal notice says please note. But look at line 2 more closely: it uses अंतिम तिथि and then इस महीने की तीस तारीख़, five words apart. तिथि is the Sanskrit-side word you met as a distractor in level 20 and तारीख़ is the Urdu-side one, and the writer moves between them inside a single sentence without noticing. That is exactly the behaviour the pairs block described.
learn.register_note_en: स्मरण रहे कि (formal notice) · याद रखें or याद दिला दूँ (speech). Nobody says स्मरण out loud.
vocabulary_notes: वार्षिक — annual, built from वर्ष with the -इक suffix.
भुगतान — payment, masculine. रद्द — cancelled, invariable, Urdu-side.
न होने पर — the oblique infinitive plus पर, negated with न as on the signs.

practice.question_en: What is the deadline for the fee?
practice.explanation_en: Line 2: इस महीने की तीस तारीख़.

game.question_en: इस बार ... भी in line 4. What does that tell you?
options: Online payment has always been available
Online payment is new this year
game.explanation_en: इस बार marks a change from previous times and भी adds it to what already existed. Neither word alone says the facility is new; together they do.

learn.title_en: अनुलग्नक — an attachment, from the verb that does everything
learn.explanation_en: अनुलग्नक is अनु- (along, after) plus a form of लगना, so it is a thing attached alongside. That is the same लगना you now have eight senses for — felt, seemed, attached, cost, began, a phone connecting, a job landing — and here it has built the word for an email attachment. Everyday speech uses अटैचमेंट, and both are heard. Note that this email uses the whole apparatus from levels 20 and 21: विषय at the top, महोदय as the salutation, सादर at the close.
learn.register_note_en: अनुलग्नक (formal writing) · अटैचमेंट (everywhere else, including most office email). The Hindi word is genuinely used, but on forms more than in inboxes.
vocabulary_notes: महोदय — Sir, in a letter. महोदया for a woman. There is no everyday equivalent; you would simply use a name.
आँकड़े — figures or data, masculine plural. It is also a level 40 reading item.
अधूरा — incomplete, and it inflects, so अधूरी रिपोर्ट.

practice.explanation_en: Line 4: कुछ आँकड़े अभी अधूरे हैं.

game.question_en: Why is he sending a report he says is incomplete?
options: So that it can be reviewed while the last figures are finished
game.explanation_en: He flags what is missing and then asks for it to be looked over anyway. The reason is in the gap between the two lines, not in either of them.

learn.title_en: -क builds the one who does it
learn.explanation_en: प्रेषक is a sender, from प्रेषण, dispatch, plus the agent suffix -क. You have already met that suffix twice without being told: सूचक, an indicator, in the level 19 game, and समर्थक, a supporter, in level 17. It is everywhere — लेखक writer, पाठक reader, दर्शक viewer, शिक्षक teacher, चालक driver. All masculine, and all built the same way. Notice too how much of this email is recycled: सूचना, मरम्मत, असुविधा and खेद all come from the lift notice back in level 14.
learn.register_note_en: प्रेषक and प्राप्तकर्ता, sender and recipient, are what an official form prints. An email client shows भेजने वाला or simply the English.
vocabulary_notes: सचिव — secretary, in the office-holder sense. आवासीय — residential, with the -ईय suffix.
पहुँचाना — to convey or deliver, the causative of पहुँचना.
इस दौरान — during this period. दौरान follows के in के दौरान but stands alone after इस.

practice.question_en: How long will the lift be out of use?

game.question_en: What does this email tell you about the person receiving it?
options: They are expected to pass it on to other people
They must reply to the secretary
They live in the building and need to know
game.explanation_en: It comes from the secretary and ends by asking that it reach all members. The recipient is a link in a chain, not the end of one.

summary.recap_en: तिथि and तारीख़ appear five words apart in one sentence, which is the pairs block in the wild. अनुलग्नक is built on लगना, the verb with eight senses. And -क builds the doer: प्रेषक, लेखक, पाठक, शिक्षक, and सूचक and समर्थक, which you had already met.
summary.next_up_en: Next: three complete formal emails — accepting, asking and complaining.

lines.read_as: saadar, raajesh varmaa

learn.explanation_en: उपस्थित means present or in attendance, and its noun उपस्थिति was a distractor in the level 18 game. Its negative is अनुपस्थित, absent, using the अन- form of the prefix before a vowel — and you will see that word in the next email. Note also यदि ... तो in line 6: यदि is the formal word for if, where speech uses अगर, and where a message often uses nothing at all and lets तो carry the whole conditional on its own.
learn.register_note_en: यदि (formal writing) · अगर (speech and ordinary writing) · nothing at all, with तो alone, in casual speech. Three ways to build a conditional, and the setting picks.
vocabulary_notes: आदरणीय — respected, with the -ईय suffix that also gave स्थानीय and आवासीय.
अवश्य — certainly, formal. Speech says ज़रूर, which appears everywhere in Module 12.
शुभकामनाएँ — good wishes, feminine plural. Used for occasions rather than for congratulations.

game.question_en: What do आदरणीय महोदया and सादर together tell you about the two people?
options: The relationship is formal — professional or civic
game.explanation_en: The register is formal at both ends of the letter and never slips in between, which is not how people write to friends.

lines.hindi: विषय: छुट्टी के लिए प्रार्थना
lines.read_as: viṣay: chhuṭṭii ke lie praarthanaa
lines.english: Subject: application for leave

lines.hindi: आदरणीय महोदय,
lines.read_as: aadarṇiiya mahoday,
lines.english: Respected sir,

lines.hindi: निवेदन है कि मुझे पारिवारिक कारणों से चार दिन की छुट्टी चाहिए
lines.read_as: nivedan hai ki mujhe paarivaarik kaaraṇoṁ se chaar din kii chhuṭṭii chaahie
lines.english: I request four days' leave for family reasons

lines.hindi: दिनांक बारह से पंद्रह मार्च तक अनुपस्थित रहूँगा
lines.read_as: dinaaṁk baarah se paṁdrah maarch tak anupasthit rahuuṁgaa
lines.english: I will be absent from the twelfth to the fifteenth of March

lines.hindi: मेरे काम की ज़िम्मेदारी श्री शर्मा सँभाल लेंगे
lines.read_as: mere kaam kii zimmedaarii shrii sharmaa saṁbhaal leṁge
lines.english: Mr Sharma will take charge of my work

lines.hindi: कृपया अनुमति प्रदान करें
lines.read_as: kripayaa anumati pradaan kareṁ
lines.english: Please grant permission

lines.hindi: आपकी अति कृपा होगी
lines.read_as: aapkii ati kripaa hogii
lines.english: I would be most grateful

lines.hindi: सादर, मोहित सिंह
lines.read_as: saadar, mohit siṁh
lines.english: Yours sincerely, Mohit Singh

learn.explanation_en: Line 4 gives you अनुपस्थित, absent — अन- plus उपस्थित from the previous item, exactly as promised. The prefix takes its अन- form because उपस्थित begins with a vowel, which is the rule you met in level 12. The target word itself, अनुमति, is permission, and it goes with देना or, more formally, प्रदान करना. Its Urdu-side partner is इजाज़त, feminine as well, so this is a matched pair.
learn.register_note_en: अनुमति (formal writing) · इजाज़त (speech). इजाज़त दीजिए is what you say before leaving somebody's house.
vocabulary_notes: पारिवारिक — family-related, from परिवार with the -इक suffix, as वार्षिक came from वर्ष.
प्रदान करना — to grant or bestow. Only ever formal.
आपकी अति कृपा होगी — a fixed closing for a request. Literally, it will be your great kindness.

practice.question_en: How long is the leave requested for?
practice.explanation_en: Line 3: चार दिन की छुट्टी, and line 4 gives the dates.

game.question_en: Why does he mention Mr Sharma at all?
options: To show the work is unimportant
To explain who Mr Sharma is
To remove the obvious objection before it can be raised
To ask Mr Sharma for permission too
game.explanation_en: The request creates a problem — who covers the work — and the next line closes it. Neither line needs the other to make sense, which is why the move is easy to miss.

lines.read_as: subah keval aadhe ghanṭe paanii aataa hai

lines.hindi: सादर, संगीता राव

learn.title_en: शिकायत has no formal partner — it is already both
learn.explanation_en: Most of the words in these emails have a partner on the other side of the register. शिकायत does not. It is Urdu-side in origin and it is also exactly what a government form, a consumer court and a police station all use — शिकायत दर्ज करें, register a complaint. That is the mirror image of उपलब्ध in level 18, which had no casual partner. Some words simply occupy the whole range, and looking for the other half wastes your time. Note that the thing complained about takes की: इसकी शिकायत.
learn.register_note_en: शिकायत covers everything from a child complaining about a sibling to a formal legal filing. There is no register decision to make.
vocabulary_notes: सप्ताह — week, formal. Speech says हफ़्ता, which you met in Module 12.
भवन — building, formal. Speech says बिल्डिंग.
शीघ्र — promptly, formal, and the item at level 52 that pairs it with जल्दी and फ़ौरन.

practice.question_en: How long has the problem been going on?

game.question_en: What is line 5 doing that lines 3 and 4 do not?
options: Explaining why she is the one writing
Turning a personal grievance into a collective one, which is harder to dismiss
game.explanation_en: The first two lines describe her own building's problem. The third makes it everyone's, which changes what the reader can do about it.

summary.recap_en: यदि, अगर and nothing-at-all are three ways of building a conditional, chosen by setting. अनुपस्थित follows उपस्थित one email later, with अन- before a vowel. And शिकायत has no register partner at all — it covers the whole range on its own, which is the mirror of उपलब्ध in level 18.
summary.next_up_en: Next: two urgent messages, and the module's first news item.

lines.hindi: कृपया ज़रूरी काम पहले निपटा लें

lines.hindi: लिफ़्ट भी बंद रहेगी

lines.hindi: पानी की मोटर भी नहीं चलेगी

lines.hindi: असुविधा के लिए खेद
lines.read_as: asuvidhaa ke lie ḳhed

lines.hindi: आवासीय समिति
lines.read_as: aavaasiiya samiti

learn.explanation_en: तत्काल is तत् (that) plus काल (time), so it means at that very time, immediately. It is the same काल you met in आपातकाल on the emergency sign in level 14. Everyday speech uses तुरंत or फ़ौरन instead, and all three are common. Note also that लिफ़्ट and मोटर are both feminine here — रहेगी and चलेगी — which is the building machinery from Module 12 turning up again.
learn.register_note_en: तत्काल (notices, and the name of Indian Railways' emergency booking quota) · तुरंत · फ़ौरन. The last is Urdu-side and comes up properly at level 53.
vocabulary_notes: निपटा लें — to get something dealt with. निपटना is taught properly at level 44; here you meet it in passing, which is what graded reading is for.
भी appearing twice, in lines 5 and 6, adding one consequence after another.
असुविधा के लिए खेद — lifted straight from the level 14 lift notice, once again.

practice.question_en: When does the power go off?

game.question_en: Why does the message mention the water pump separately?
options: Because no power means no pump, which residents might not think through
The pump is being repaired too
The pump runs on a generator
The pump has its own fault
game.explanation_en: The power cut is the cause and the pump is a consequence of it. Spelling out the consequence is the whole reason the line exists.

lines.hindi: नमस्ते, आपका आवेदन मिल गया था

learn.title_en: -ति — the fourth abstract-noun suffix, and also feminine
learn.explanation_en: स्वीकृति is approval, built from स्वीकार करना, to accept, with the suffix -ति. That gives you four suffixes that build abstract nouns — -आई as in सच्चाई, -ई as in आज़ादी, -ता as in आवश्यकता, and now -ति as in स्वीकृति, प्रगति, शक्ति, गति, उन्नति. Every single one of them produces a feminine noun, without exception. Four different suffixes, one reliable gender, which is about as much regularity as Hindi ever offers.
learn.register_note_en: स्वीकृति (Sanskrit-side) · मंज़ूरी (Urdu-side), and both are feminine. The message uses स्वीकृति in line 2 and मंज़ूर in line 3, one line apart, without any awkwardness.
vocabulary_notes: आवेदन — an application, masculine. आवेदन करना, to apply.
जमा करा दीजिएगा — the second causative of जमा करना: have it deposited, rather than deposit it yourself.
लौटने पर — the oblique infinitive plus पर, meaning when you return.

practice.question_en: What must he hand in at the office?
practice.explanation_en: Line 4: एंट्री कार्ड जमा करा दीजिएगा.

game.question_en: Why is the entry card taken?
options: It is a routine security measure for the days he is away
game.explanation_en: It is taken and then given straight back on his return. A card handed back is not a penalty.

learn.title_en: The first news item, and what news writing does
learn.explanation_en: निवासी is a resident, from निवास, residence, plus -ई — a second agent suffix alongside the -क of प्रेषक two levels ago. But the more useful thing here is the shape of the text. Every claim is attributed: नगर निगम के अनुसार, स्थानीय निवासियों ने, कुछ लोगों ने, अधिकारियों ने. The report never says anything in its own voice, and it puts the welcome and the complaint side by side without choosing. That structure is what makes news dense with ने and with के अनुसार.
learn.register_note_en: के अनुसार (news, formal writing) · के हिसाब से (speech, and you met it in a Module 12 office argument). Both mean according to.
vocabulary_notes: वाहन — vehicle, formal. Speech says गाड़ी. वाहनों is the oblique plural before को.
स्वागत करना — to welcome. स्वागत is masculine, hence किया.
आश्वासन — an assurance, and the standard word for an official promise.
निवासी is the same in the direct singular and the direct plural. It becomes निवासियों only before a postposition.

practice.question_en: How long is the work expected to take?

game.question_en: Lines 4 and 5 appear to disagree. What is the report doing?
options: Suggesting the complaints came from outside the area
Reporting both the welcome and the complaints without judging between them
Saying the residents changed their minds
game.explanation_en: Both lines are attributed to different groups. Setting them next to each other and taking no side is the convention, not an error.

summary.recap_en: -ति joins -आई, -ई and -ता as a fourth abstract-noun suffix, and all four are reliably feminine. The approval message uses स्वीकृति and मंज़ूर one line apart. And the first news item attributes every single claim, which is why news Hindi is so dense with ने and के अनुसार.
summary.next_up_en: Next: back to vocabulary — the last three Urdu-side pairs, and then the language of news.
